scope_note: Candidate inventory is triage, not a complete source audit. Deep findings are documented in the companion report. No Ukrainian Modernism research or production was performed.

candidates.name: W3C EPUBCheck
candidates.note: Official EPUB conformance checker; local run blocked by missing Java/runtime network.

candidates.name: DAISY Ace
candidates.note: Accessibility report CLI; supplement human review.

candidates.name: Keepa Python client
candidates.note: Client is OSS; data requires recurring paid API subscription and credential controls.

candidates.name: KDP Scout
candidates.note: Local snapshots useful; Amazon scraping and optional paid DataForSEO are fragile/policy sensitive.

candidates.name: Google Books API
candidates.note: Discovery only; assess quota, completeness, and known-record recall.

candidates.name: Open Library APIs
candidates.note: Useful discovery/cross-reference; incomplete and not rights evidence.

candidates.name: BnF data.bnf.fr
candidates.note: Strong French bibliographic/authority discovery source; primary portal identified, adapter details remain to be benchmarked.

candidates.name: Project Gutenberg Ebookmaker
candidates.note: Mature tests but specialized to Gutenberg conventions; not ABVX default converter.

candidates.name: trendspyg
candidates.note: Google Trends is unofficial/volatile and not book sales; exploratory signal only.

candidates.name: KDP Scraper
candidates.note: Low maturity, paid scraping providers, limited test evidence.

candidates.name: MCP-KDP-Niche-Research
candidates.note: Scoring/MCP patterns only; inferred-sales scores and license uncertainty disqualify adoption.

candidates.name: kdp-niche-analyzer
candidates.note: Tiny static UI, no tests/data integration, no license found.

candidates.name: SerpApi Amazon Engine
candidates.note: Paid third-party search abstraction; no spend or dependence justified.

candidates.name: DataForSEO
candidates.note: Paid structured search provider; compare only under separate cost approval.

candidates.name: Rainforest API
candidates.note: Paid Amazon data proxy; risks and cost require independent approval.

candidates.name: ScrapingBee
candidates.note: Paid scraping infrastructure is not a safe default.

candidates.name: ScrapingAnt
candidates.note: Proxy/scraper dependency; no adoption.

candidates.name: Oxylabs
candidates.note: Paid proxy/data service; no adoption.

candidates.name: Amazon Product Advertising API SDKs
candidates.note: Official access/eligibility and scope differ from broad editorial discovery; verify current program terms.

candidates.name: KDP downloadable reports
candidates.note: Best source for ABVX-owned sales/reads; export remains human-controlled.

candidates.name: Google Trends UI
candidates.note: Relative interest only; not sales or absolute volume.

candidates.name: pytrends
candidates.note: Unofficial interface with breakage risk; prefer no dependency.

candidates.name: Google Trends official API
candidates.note: Check availability/eligibility before use; do not assume public access.

candidates.name: WorldCat Search API
candidates.note: Potential holdings discovery, access and reuse conditions need qualification.

candidates.name: Sudoc / ABES services
candidates.note: French university catalogue/authority discovery; verify endpoints and reuse.

candidates.name: Internet Archive metadata/advanced search
candidates.note: Discovery and digitized-source access do not confer rights.

candidates.name: Project Gutenberg catalogue
candidates.note: Item-level copyright and jurisdiction checks required.

candidates.name: Wikisource
candidates.note: Useful transcription discovery; validate edition, transcription and territorial status.

candidates.name: Crossref REST API
candidates.note: Relevant for scholarly sources, not commercial demand.

candidates.name: OpenAlex API
candidates.note: Scholarly graph only; not book-market evidence.

candidates.name: EbookLib
candidates.note: Python EPUB manipulation possible; copyleft and overlap require review.

candidates.name: Calibre / ebook-convert
candidates.note: Broad converter/reader; existing Pandoc path is established; licensing and output review required.

candidates.name: Sigil
candidates.note: Useful manual EPUB editor, not a pipeline service.

candidates.name: Pandoc
candidates.note: Already used in ABVX generation; no replacement needed.

candidates.name: DAISY Pipeline 2
candidates.note: Large specialized workflow; Ace/EPUBCheck are narrower first improvements.

candidates.name: Paged.js
candidates.note: HTML paged-media option; current XeLaTeX output means no demonstrated gap.

candidates.name: Vivliostyle
candidates.note: HTML/CSS typesetting alternative; avoid migration without layout benchmark.

candidates.name: WeasyPrint
candidates.note: PDF engine alternative; current toolchain exists.

candidates.name: qpdf
candidates.note: Available locally and already useful for structural PDF checks.

candidates.name: Ghostscript
candidates.note: Available locally; track use/distribution obligations.

candidates.name: Poppler utilities
candidates.note: Available locally for info and image rendering.

candidates.name: pdfcpu
candidates.note: Could add checks if a concrete gap appears; not currently installed.

candidates.name: veraPDF
candidates.note: PDF/A conformance is not equivalent to KDP print acceptance.

candidates.name: pikepdf
candidates.note: Python qpdf bindings; redundant absent a code-level need.

candidates.name: PyMuPDF
candidates.note: License-sensitive and overlaps Poppler/PDF tools.

candidates.name: ExifTool
candidates.note: Useful metadata inspection, not a book-specific validation stack.

candidates.name: Okapi Framework
candidates.note: Mature localization toolkit; only relevant if terminology/TM exchange becomes a real workflow need.

candidates.name: OmegaT
candidates.note: CAT tool, not an automatic translation quality gate.

candidates.name: Translate Toolkit
candidates.note: File-format/TM tooling; no current integration need established.

candidates.name: LiteLLM
candidates.note: Existing ABVX provider/cost controls should be preferred; new routing layer adds complexity.

candidates.name: Langfuse
candidates.note: Potential tracing but substantial operational surface; existing checkpoints/provenance first.

candidates.name: DVC
candidates.note: Existing Git/artifact conventions may suffice; no demonstrated dataset-scale need.
